name: Instagram
description: Instagram integration for content publishing, comments, and insights. Requires a Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page.

client_id.title: Facebook App ID
client_id.description: Your Facebook App ID from Meta for Developers

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: OAuth access token (populated automatically after authorization)

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token (populated automatically after authorization)

instagram_user_id.title: Instagram Business Account ID
instagram_user_id.description: Your Instagram Business or Creator Account ID (found in Facebook Page settings > Instagram > Connected Account)

instagram_create_image_container.description: Create a media container for an image post. Use publish_media to publish it after creation.

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the image to publish

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Post caption (max 2,200 characters). Supports hashtags and @mentions.

location_id.title: Location ID
location_id.description: Facebook Page location ID to tag

user_tags.title: User Tags
user_tags.description: Users to tag in the image. Each tag: { username, x, y } where x/y are 0-1 coordinates.

instagram_create_video_container.description: Create a media container for a video or Reel. Processing is async, so use check_container_status to poll, then publish_media when FINISHED.

video_url.title: Video URL
video_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the video to publish

share_to_feed.title: Share to Feed
share_to_feed.description: Whether to also share the reel to the main feed

thumb_offset.title: Thumbnail Offset (ms)
thumb_offset.description: Time in milliseconds for the video thumbnail

location_id.title: Location ID
location_id.description: Facebook Page location ID to tag

instagram_create_carousel_container.description: Create a carousel media container from child containers. Create image/video containers first, then pass their IDs as children.

children.title: Child Container IDs
children.description: Array of media container IDs to include in the carousel (2-10 items)

location_id.title: Location ID
location_id.description: Facebook Page location ID to tag

instagram_check_container_status.description: Check the processing status of a media container. For video containers, poll until status_code is FINISHED before publishing.

container_id.title: Container ID
container_id.description: The media container ID returned from create_image/video/carousel_container

instagram_publish_media.description: Publish a prepared media container (image, video, or carousel). The container must be fully processed before publishing.

creation_id.title: Creation ID
creation_id.description: The container ID to publish (from create_image/video/carousel_container)

instagram_get_account_info.description: Retrieve the connected Instagram Business or Creator account details

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return

instagram_list_media.description: List the authenticated user's Instagram posts with engagement metrics

after.title: After Cursor
after.description: Pagination cursor for the next page

instagram_get_media.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific Instagram post

media_id.title: Media ID
media_id.description: The ID of the Instagram post

instagram_get_media_insights.description: Retrieve engagement metrics (impressions, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves) for a published post

media_id.title: Media ID
media_id.description: The ID of the Instagram post to get insights for

metric.title: Metrics
metric.description: Comma-separated list of metrics to retrieve

instagram_get_account_insights.description: Retrieve account-level analytics (impressions, reach, follower count, profile views) over a time period

since.title: Since
since.description: Unix timestamp for the start of the range

until.title: Until
until.description: Unix timestamp for the end of the range

instagram_list_comments.description: Retrieve comments on an Instagram post, including nested replies

media_id.title: Media ID
media_id.description: The ID of the Instagram post

after.title: After Cursor
after.description: Pagination cursor for the next page

instagram_reply_to_comment.description: Post a reply to an existing comment on an Instagram post

comment_id.title: Comment ID
comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to reply to

example_parameters.message: Thanks for your comment! We appreciate the feedback.

instagram_hide_comment.description: Hide or unhide a comment on an Instagram post

comment_id.title: Comment ID
comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to hide or unhide

hide.title: Hide
hide.description: true to hide the comment, false to unhide

instagram_delete_comment.description: Delete a comment on an Instagram post

comment_id.title: Comment ID
comment_id.description: The ID of the comment to delete

instagram_search_hashtag.description: Search for a hashtag ID by name. Use the returned ID with get_hashtag_top_media or get_hashtag_recent_media.

user_id.title: Instagram User ID
user_id.description: Your Instagram Business Account ID (required for rate limiting)

q.title: Hashtag
q.description: The hashtag name to search for (without #)

instagram_get_hashtag_top_media.description: Get the top-performing media for a specific hashtag

instagram_get_hashtag_recent_media.description: Get the most recent media for a specific hashtag

instagram_get_mentioned_media.description: Retrieve media where the authenticated user is mentioned or tagged

instagram_get_mentioned_comments.description: Retrieve comments where the authenticated user is mentioned

instagram_business_discovery.description: Look up another Instagram Business/Creator account's public profile and recent media using Graph API field expansion

ig_user_id.title: Your Instagram User ID
ig_user_id.description: Your Instagram Business Account ID (used for authentication context)

fields.title: Fields (Graph API Expansion)
fields.description: Graph API field expansion query. Use business_discovery.fields(...) syntax with target username. Example: business_discovery.fields(username,name,followers_count,media.limit(5){caption,like_count,timestamp}){@targetusername}
